title: Drain transport readers before closing telemetry runs
body: ACP stdout and stderr readers can still hold final JSON-RPC lines after the child reports exit. Closing the telemetry run first removes its projector, so late responses lose stop reasons, usage, and turn association.
resolution: Make the process monitor the sole normal closer, join both reader threads before run_end, preserve an explicit kill or app-shutdown reason, and make run_end first-close-wins.
